summary: Defines an IPv6 Hop-by-Hop option that tells transit routers to look more closely at a packet instead of just forwarding it. It is used by protocols that need routers along the path to inspect certain messages. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: It is a sticker on a package saying every post office on the way should open this one and read it.

questions: what is the ipv6 router alert option
how do routers inspect special ipv6 packets
